identity_findings: Primary prelink dictionary KCID is copied into kernelcache_uuid and exported via kern.kernelcacheuuid.
Bootstrap UUID validation branch is conditional on Auxiliary collection; primary startup publishes the supplied ID without comparing it to an old disk ID in this function.
mapKCFileSet path is inside an x86 conditional, but validateKCFileSetUUID itself and bootstrap Auxiliary branch are present on ARM64; do not call the validator entirely absent.
CONFIG_IMAGEBOOT_CHUNKLIST is disabled in the exact imageboot compile recipe; authenticate_bootkc_uuid/root_version_check symbols are absent in these three complete bound kernels.
The built kernel is not MH_FILESET. Auxiliary collection reachability and all other consumers are not yet proven.

Design relaxed atomic counters and bounded last-event timing for retirement and each vsync event category; distinguish a send attempt from userspace receipt.
